description: This file defines a Python class 'rml_parse' that extends 'report_sxw.rml_parse' and includes methods for formatting numbers, dates, and strings, as well as handling text encoding and report header customization. It appears to be part of an Odoo (OpenERP) reporting module for account vouchers.

classes.name: rml_parse
